# d3d9.dll shim: proxies the system d3d9.dll, records what vanilla gta_sa.exe asks
# of D3D9, makes it borderless, and hosts the build-guarded in-memory patches.
# src/gen/ is generated by tools/gen_d3d9_proxy.py.
add_library(agpu_d3d9 SHARED
  d3d9.def
  src/dllmain.cpp
  src/log.cpp
  src/patch.cpp
  src/game_hooks.cpp
  src/recorder.cpp
  src/display.cpp
  src/d3d9_proxy.cpp
  src/resources.cpp
  src/gen/d3d9_proxy_forward.cpp
  src/config.cpp
  src/widescreen.cpp
  src/mouse.cpp
  src/webgpu/backend.cpp
  src/webgpu/ffshader.cpp
  src/webgpu/shader_translator.cpp
)
set_target_properties(agpu_d3d9 PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME d3d9)
target_include_directories(agpu_d3d9 PRIVATE src)
target_compile_definitions(agpu_d3d9 PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
target_compile_options(agpu_d3d9 PRIVATE /W4 /permissive-)
# The real d3d9.dll is loaded by path at runtime; don't link against it.
# webgpu_dawn.dll is delay-loaded: only touched when the mirror/backend starts, so
# the game's startup DirectX check and mirror-off runs never load Dawn.
target_link_libraries(agpu_d3d9 PRIVATE dawn_webgpu delayimp)
target_link_options(agpu_d3d9 PRIVATE /SAFESEH:NO /DELAYLOAD:webgpu_dawn.dll)
add_custom_command(TARGET agpu_d3d9 POST_BUILD
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different ${DAWN_RUNTIME_FILES} $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:agpu_d3d9>)
